data.desc: Viking (NYSE: VIK) is a global leader in experiential travel with a fleet of more than 100 ships, exploring 21 rivers, five oceans and all seven continents. Designed for curious travelers with interests in science, history, culture and cuisine, Executive Chairman Torstein Hagen often says Viking offers experiences For The Thinking Person. Viking has more than 450 awards to its name, including being rated #1 for Rivers and #1 for Oceans five years in a row by Conde Nast Traveler in the 2025 Readers' Choice Awards. Viking is also rated a 'World's Best' by Travel + Leisure-no other travel company has simultaneously received such honors by both publications.
